name: Hinata no Tsuki
source:
A "human" decided to start a life of seclusion by moving into the forest. Shortly after entering the forest, he happened to rescue an elf in distress, and the elf, named Hinata, became fond of him. They parted ways with a promise to meet occasionally. However, that very night, a visitor arrived at the mountain hut. Initially, thinking it was the elf from daytime, the human attempted to reprimand the visitor, only to discover it was another elf named Konomi. Konomi enjoyed the pleasant punishment and also grew attached to the human.

The next morning, Hinata also arrived, and two adorable elves settled beside the human. When Konomi and Hinata went out to search for food, they were intercepted by a hostile elf named Ibara, who intended to bring them back. According to Ibara, the boundary between the elf world and the human world weakened due to a lunar eclipse.

The human, who had previously helped a dark elf named Tsukiyo, enjoyed interacting with the elves and reading the books left in the mountain hut. However, he learned that on the night of the full moon, the boundary would be restored, and the elves needed to return to their original world. Having discovered that the indigenous inhabitants of the mountain hut were also studying elves, the human followed their research and ended up living with the elves.
translation:
一个“人类”决定搬进森林开始隐居生活。进入森林后不久，他偶然救助了一位落难的精灵，而那个名叫日向的精灵对他产生了好感。他们分道扬镳，并承诺偶尔见面。然而就在当天晚上，山间小屋来了一位客人。最初，人类以为是白天的精灵，试图斥责来访者，结果发现这是另一个名叫科诺米的精灵。科诺米享受着令人愉快的惩罚，也对人类产生了依恋。

第二天早上，日向也来了，两个可爱的精灵坐在了人类的身边。当Konomi和Hinata外出寻找食物时，他们被一个名叫Ibara的敌对精灵拦截，他打算将他们带回来。根据伊原的说法，精灵世界和人类世界之间的界限因为月食而减弱了。

这个人类曾经帮助过一个名叫月夜的黑暗精灵，喜欢与精灵互动，喜欢阅读山间小屋里留下的书籍。然而他得知，月圆之夜，结界将会恢复，精灵们需要回到原来的世界。发现山间小屋的原住民也在研究精灵后，人类跟随他们的研究，最终与精灵一起生活。
